items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: Don't you know Lawrence went to work at a furniture store with Abby?

ctx.x: He worked at a furniture store on Frenchman Street with Abby.
Remember? You know Abby. Who? Don't you know Lawrence went to work at a furniture store with Abby? Oh yeah, with Abby. Well they worked at a furniture store. That was in the 40s. Everything... 19...
